name: Otio
description_en:
Otio is a research workspace for gathering PDFs, articles, videos, transcripts and data, then asking questions across those sources. Its main task is the work before writing: finding themes, contradictions and passages that support a draft.

Projects retain sources and conversations, while model comparison and source-linked answers help a reader investigate a question. A citation is a route back to evidence, not proof that the generated interpretation is correct.
description_zh:
Otio 是研究工作空间，收集 PDF、文章、视频、转录及数据，并跨来源提问。核心是写作前的主题、矛盾及支持段落整理。

项目保存来源与对话，模型比较和带来源回答帮助调查问题；引用是返回证据的路径，不证明生成解释正确。

core_features.explanation_en: Ask about themes and contradictions across a project library.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跨项目资料库提问主题及矛盾。

core_features.explanation_en: Inspect cited pages or timestamps and export notes as Markdown.
core_features.explanation_zh: 检查引用页或时间戳，并导出 Markdown 笔记。

en: Synthesize contrasting studies into checked source-linked notes.
zh: 将有分歧研究整理为已核来源笔记。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Create a nonconfidential project, compare source passages with answers and inspect the Markdown export.
steps.zh: 创建非机密项目，对照原文和回答并检查 Markdown 导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription by research volume and workspace/upload allowances.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free with limited usage. Annual cards Lite $7/month, Go $18, Pro $45; daily upload, storage and PDF limits apply. Unlimited wording, Free ten-file/day definition and stray currency label need clarification.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费但限用；年付折合 Lite 月 $7、Go $18、Pro $45，上传/存储/PDF 均有限。不限宣传、免费十文件/每日口径及残留币种需澄清。

sources.title: Otio: AI research workspace for hundreds of sources
sources.research_notes_en: Source-based research workspace with multi-source questions, page/passage citations and project organization.

sources.title: Otio pricing: every model on every plan
sources.research_notes_en: July 7 2026 pricing: annual equivalents and actual upload/storage caps conflict with unlimited headlines; no checkout tested.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Build a source map before drafting
sections.en: For an illustrative literature review, separate the question, methods, findings and limitations for each paper. Ask for disagreements and open each cited passage before combining findings. Do not treat several summaries of the same underlying study as independent evidence. Page-level links help inspection but extraction errors, missing context and unsupported synthesis still need human correction.
sections.zh: 例如文献综述，先分开各论文的问题、方法、发现及限制，再问分歧并打开每条引用。不能把同一研究的多个摘要当独立证据。页级链接方便检查，但提取错误、缺上下文和无支持综合仍需人工纠正。

sections.title_en: Price the actual upload and storage limits
sections.title_zh: 按真实上传与存储上限选型
sections.en: Annual-billed cards display Lite $7/month ($84/year), Go $18 ($216) and Pro $45 ($540). Free lists ten files, 25MB/file and 50MB total; the comparison table instead calls this ten uploads/day. Paid daily upload limits are 50/250/500 with PDF limits of 500/1,000/2,000 pages. These caps contradict broad no-upload-limit language. A stray £540/year appears on Free; it is not a usable Free price. Confirm limits and billing before purchase.
sections.zh: 年付卡片 Lite 月 $7/年 $84，Go $18/$216，Pro $45/$540。Free 列 10 文件、每个 25MB、总 50MB，比较表却称每日 10 上传；付费每日 50/250/500，PDF 500/1,000/2,000 页，和不限上传宣传冲突。Free 旁残留 £540/年不能当免费报价，购买前需确认。

sections.en: The page describes cloud-drive connections, Zotero/Mendeley desktop access on paid tiers and delivery through channels such as email or Drive. Those involve separate credentials and destination permissions. Start with nonconfidential sources, inspect exported Markdown and disable unintended delivery. Model availability, exact AI usage units and unsupported-source behavior were not tested.
sections.zh: 页面介绍云盘连接、付费 Zotero/Mendeley 桌面访问及邮件/Drive 交付，需独立凭据和目标权限。先用非机密资料、检查 Markdown 导出并关闭非预期发送。模型可用性、AI 用量单位及不支持来源的行为均未测。

sections.title_en: Use it for accumulated research with verification
sections.title_zh: 适合有核查的持续研究
sections.en: Otio merits evaluation when research grows over weeks and a reader needs to revisit source passages. A short one-off question may not need a persistent library. Test a scanned page, a contradictory pair and an answer absent from the sources. No connector, upload, export or cited answer was executed, and sensitive-data retention and model-provider terms remain unverified.
sections.zh: 研究持续数周且需要重访原文时可评估 Otio，短期单问未必需要资料库。应测试扫描页、冲突来源及资料中没有的答案。本文未执行连接、上传、导出或引用回答，敏感数据保留及模型条款未核。

research_gaps: No research, model, file, citation, integration or export was tested.
Upload definitions, AI usage, actual quote, privacy, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
